description: This file defines a sealed internal exception class 'MemoryStorageEtagMismatchException' used within the Orleans storage system to signal an ETag mismatch during memory storage operations. It includes properties for stored and received ETags, constructors, serialization methods, and a conversion to an 'InconsistentStateException'.

classes.name: MemoryStorageEtagMismatchException
classes.description: An internal exception class used to indicate ETag mismatches in memory storage, integrating serialization support and conversion to an 'InconsistentStateException'.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with stored and received ETag values.

methods.description: Converts this exception into an 'InconsistentStateException' with a detailed message.
